answer: For `IllegalArgumentException`: condition avoided (argument is positive). For `InterruptedException`: condition not avoided (no prevention of thread interruption).
remark: `InterruptedException` can be thrown when a thread is interrupted while sleeping. In this snippet, the thread may be interrupted by another thread calling `Thread.interrupt()` on it, causing the sleep to throw this exception. Even though it is caught, the condition is not prevented from occurring.
